title_en: Video Game Release Dates: The Biggest Games Coming Soon - IGN
summary_en: An updated list of video game release dates for PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Switch 2, and PC games.
body_en:
September is here, which means fans of video games have a whole new month's worth of PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC games to choose from. This month is huge, as all the year's biggest games are fleeing November to escape GTA 6. So you'll get games like Marvel's Wolverine, Control Resonant, The Blood of Dawnwalker, Onimusha: Way of the Sword, Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave, Silent Hill Townfall, and a bunch more. Read on to see release dates for all the biggest games and expansions coming out this month and beyond. Let's have a look.
If you're the preordering type, you can click the links for the platform of your choice to see the game at Amazon (if available).
For more release dates, check out our ongoing list of 4K UHD and Blu-ray release dates as well as all of the upcoming LEGO release dates .
